intro: Week 2 is in the books. Two teams are still perfect and two are still looking for their first win.

blurbs.10: Already beat the #2 and #3 teams. The only unbeaten team that has fully earned it.
blurbs.9: Josh Allen's 46.82 was the best individual game of the week. The scary part is the 39.3 points still sitting on the bench.
blurbs.5: Second-best score of the week and a loss to show for it. Nothing wrong here that a little luck won't fix.
blurbs.7: Goff went for 37.78 and it still wasn't enough. Solidly above average, just ran into the Allen show.
blurbs.4: Survived by 0.26 and has faced the fourth-most points in the league. Bryce Young's 30.08 on the bench says the ceiling is higher.
blurbs.8: 2-0 on the eighth-best scoring and the softest schedule in the league. The team that's 18-0 in all-play is up next.
blurbs.3: From 142.16 in Week 1 to the lowest score of Week 2. Biggest faller.
blurbs.2: 93.44 would have lost to anyone but the team they drew. CeeDee is doing a lot of carrying.
blurbs.6: Winless, but outscoring 1-1 Mayo Clinic and 2-0 The real Mr Ez. Starting DJ Moore (-0.1) didn't help.
blurbs.1: Last in points, and one of the two losses was by 0.26. Same all-play record as the 2-0 real Mr Ez, which says plenty about luck.

recap.1: Lamb (31.3) outscored everybody on the field in the lowest-scoring game of the week.
recap.2: Kincaid's 22.5 was just enough. Flip to Best lineups: both teams left 35-plus on the bench, and it still comes down to 0.28 the other way.
recap.3: Allen beat Goff by 9 in the QB duel, and Cook and Henry outscored Tuten and Swift 36.6 to 23.6.
recap.4: Stafford's 34.98 did the heavy lifting against a lineup that got -0.1 out of DJ Moore.
recap.5: Game of the week. JSN and Mahomes edged Purdy, St. Brown and a surprise 26 from Dalton Schultz.

preview.3: A coin flip on paper, with four questionable starters between them. The injury report probably decides this one.
preview.4: Purdy vs Goff after both went for 30-plus last week. The Butter Boys have scored the third-most points and are due a little luck.
preview.2: Mayo is rolling with Malik Willis at QB and a questionable Nabers. They need CeeDee to go nuclear again.
preview.1: A bounce-back spot for Lamar and the Facilitator. EZ-Bee-Z has the lowest projection of the week, so check that bench before kickoff.
preview.5: The 2-0 real Mr Ez runs into the league's best team with three questionable starters. The softest schedule in the league just got a lot harder.
